json_schema.title: cp.get_dir
json_schema.description: Used to recursively copy a directory from the salt master

path.ui:title: Source path
path.ui:description: Salt fileserver URL of the directory to copy (e.g. salt://path/to/dir or with ?saltenv=query)

dest.ui:title: Destination path
dest.ui:description: Absolute directory path on the minion where the contents should be placed

template.ui:title: Template
template.ui:description: Render source/destination names with a templating engine (e.g. jinja)

gzip.ui:title: Gzip
gzip.ui:description: For larger files, the cp.get_file module also supports gzip compression. Because gzip is CPU-intensive, this should only be used in scenarios where the compression ratio is very high (e.g. pretty-printed JSON or YAML files). Use the gzip named argument to enable it. Valid values are 1..9, where 1 is the lightest compression and 9 the heaviest. 1 uses the least CPU on the master (and minion), 9 uses the most
